characters.name: Konen
characters.description: A middle-aged woman with a sturdy build, often wearing practical clothing suitable for farm work. She has a serious and determined expression, reflecting her mission to find a trustworthy shepherd. Her demeanor is that of a seasoned farmer, sensible and no-nonsense, navigating the forest environment with purpose. The forest setting adds a sense of her being someone who is comfortable in rural and natural surroundings.

characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: A large and imposing bear, with a strong and robust physique. Its fur is thick and shaggy, a deep brown color. The bear has a curious but slightly menacing facial expression, suggesting its natural wildness and strength. The bear stands in the forest environment, emphasizing its natural habitat. Its demeanor is straightforward, and its voice is gruff when attempting to lure.

characters.name: Ulven
characters.description: A sly-looking wolf with a lean and agile body. Its fur is mixed shades of grey and black, with sharp, alert eyes that suggest cunning and intelligence. The wolf's expression is earnest but carries an underlying air of mischief, indicative of a creature with ulterior motives. In the forest surroundings, the wolf blends into the shadows, and its voice has an eerie tone as it tries to entice.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: A clever-looking fox with an elegant and somewhat cunning appearance. Its fur is a rich reddish-orange, with its signature white-tipped tail standing out. The fox has an intelligent and sly expression, and its demeanor is charming, smooth-talking, and deceptive. When it speaks, its voice is melodic and persuasive, fitting into the lush forest setting as it subtly manipulates the situation to its advantage.
